title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-12-23
lineage: SBD > Master Reel? > Master Cassette > Cassette > CoolEdit > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: A stellar sound‑board capture of a 1970 show where the band rides an explosive Good Lovin' jam and Bobby McGee with crystal‑clear mix.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, well‑balanced soundboard mix that lets every instrument shine, despite occasional “Bear pushing too hard” noise. Musically the performance is hailed as a peak‑era 1970 outing, highlighted by Jerry’s incendiary leads on Good Lovin' and a groovy Bobby McGee rendition, with the whole band in top form.

ai_rating.rationale: All 12 reviews are 4‑5 stars, consistently lauding both the performance (especially Good Lovin' and Bobby McGee) and the high‑quality soundboard mix; therefore a strong positive rating is warranted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note a great mix, crisp clarity, perfect balance and “fantastic” sound, with only minor noise spots when the band pushes hard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as a seamless, high‑energy ride—an acoustic intro leading into a full electric burst that culminates in an unforgettable Good Lovin' jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers call his leads on Good Lovin' "smoking", "righteous licks" and a "won man show of uninhibited riffology".
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bear) is praised for digging deep into Bobby McGee and delivering a hard‑grooving performance, even if his amp pushes the mix a bit.
band_member_comments.Drums: Post‑drums Good Lovin' jam highlighted; drumming energy contributes to the overall intensity.
